comparison_rules.primary_endpoint: cumulative T2 Dack-cast rate, paired same seeds
comparison_rules.valid_contrast: one-for-one direct card substitution on otherwise identical 99-card backgrounds within one validated matched trial
comparison_rules.do_not: Do not infer a card's marginal independent value from multi-card packages, do not pool different policies, or mistake repeated contrasts for independent confirmation
comparison_rules.effect_status: Exploratory; correlated re-use of games, multiple comparisons, provisional leaderboard; independent held-out confirmation required.

n256_independent_heldout.note: The historical double-Key package's 95% T2 CI crosses zero; not evidence that each individual Key is better.

n128_voltaic_vs_candelabra.note: Historical Standard policy, different fixed 34-land deck; CI crosses zero.

live_note: Interim ranks are based only on completed shard artifacts, NOT a complete independent replicate.
